featured_reviews.name: Mehak Nakte
featured_reviews.review_text:
7th June was my dad’s 54th birthday, and I wanted to surprise him with a cake that truly matched his personality.

Since Black Forest has been his favorite flavor since childhood, I was specifically looking for a fondant cake in that flavor.

Unfortunately, a nearby cake shop declined my request.

I decided to try my luck and gave Ribbon & balloons a call.

It was already around 6:00 PM on Saturday, and I needed the cake by Sunday morning.

Mr. Moin patiently understood all my requirements and assured me that they could make it happen.

I was so happy when I received the cake! It looked exactly how I had imagined.

The cake topper, sprinkles, and all the decorative elements were safely packed in a separate box, showing great attention to detail.

The staff was extremely helpful and courteous throughout the process. To top it all off, I got this customized cake for under ₹1,300, whereas other shops had quoted me ₹1,600–₹1,700 for a similar design.

The cake tasted delicious, looked amazing, and made my dad’s birthday extra special.

Thank you, Mr. Moin and the entire team, for going the extra mile. Highly recommended!

This cake shop is well-known for its delicious cakes, pastries, puffs, and pizzas, but what really stands out is the excellent cake presentation and the freshness of all their products. They use only fresh ingredients daily and maintain a high level of hygiene, which is very impressive.
They’ve recently launched a new collection called "Crave", and we had the chance to try the Irish Brew Cake and the Kunafa Cake – both were absolutely amazing in taste and presentation! We also saw their newly introduced Charm Cake, which looked stunning.
If you’re planning a birthday party or any celebration, we highly recommend Ribbons and Balloons Cake Shop. Definitely worth a visit or order – you won’t be disappointed!

featured_reviews.review_text: Have heard so much of this place and I’ve tried their food before but that was years ago. Seems like the quality has deteriorated. We went here to grab some breakfast items. We got chicken cutlets, chicken strudel, mutton patties, and choco chip brownies. The mutton patties had no trace of mutton whatsoever. The chicken cutlets were tad bit too dry with a thick outer layer. I did quite enjoy it though because it was spicy. I liked the Chicken strudel, it was spicy and there were shredded chicken inside. I especially liked the choco chip brownies, but at a bakery, you can’t really go wrong with brownies. Overall, I will recommend the chicken strudel and the choco chip brownie but it’s not really anything must have. Sad to see how their quality isn’t the same anymore.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience with Celejor.

On 8th April, I placed an order for a 3 kg cake worth INR 4340/- and paid the full amount upfront. The order was confirmed. Shockingly, the very next day, your delivery agent collected the same payment again from our office assistant, who was unaware that the payment had already been made.

When this serious error was brought to your notice, there was ZERO accountability from your team. Instead of immediately refunding the excess amount, we were told that a refund was “not possible” and that a credit note would be issued. On what basis? Since when do customers fund your business interest-free for your mistakes?

INR 4340/- is not a negligible amount, and withholding it under the guise of a credit note is completely unacceptable and unethical.

The situation worsened when we visited your store today 24th April 2026 There was not even a basic apology or acknowledgment of the mistake. Your representative gave illogical explanations about “delivery charges,” despite full payment already being made. When asked to speak to the manager, he conveniently avoided facing us and kept us waiting with excuses like “cash shortage.” For a brand of your scale, this is beyond embarrassing.

Only after repeated pressure and multiple calls was the amount finally returned. Ironically, the manager chose to appear only after the issue was resolved, clearly avoiding responsibility.

This entire incident reflects extremely poor management, lack of integrity, and complete disregard for customers. Mistakes can happen, but refusing to correct them promptly and attempting to withhold money is unacceptable.

Customers deserve honesty, accountability, and basic respect—none of which were demonstrated here.

featured_reviews.name: Rizwan Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: My recent visit to Crystal Bakery left me deeply disappointed. The staff's arrogance and lack of customer service skills were evident from the start. They don't accept Google Pay, relying solely on cash, which is inconvenient in this day and age. The owner's demeanor was particularly appalling; he made customers feel unwelcome and undervalued. It's alarming how simple interactions can leave one feeling like a burden. The owner's behavior borders on ruthlessness, fostering a hostile atmosphere. No customer should feel they're receiving a favor by making a purchase. I was compelled to file a police complaint due to this mistreatment. Crystal Bakery must address these issues urgently to regain trust. Until then, I can't recommend it.
